ios.desc:
Finally, a website builder that actually gets it.

You've got ideas. Maybe it's a portfolio to show off your work, a landing page for your side project, or a blog where you finally share those thoughts bouncing around your head. The problem? Building a website feels like it requires a computer science degree, three weekends, and a very strong coffee.

Not anymore.

Pocket Site is the AI website builder that lives in your pocket. Just describe what you want — "build me a photography portfolio with a dark theme" or "create a landing page for my coffee shop" — and watch your site come to life in seconds. Real code. Real design. Really yours.

DESCRIBE IT. BUILD IT. SHIP IT.
Tell the AI your vision in plain English. Want a hero section with a gradient background? Just ask. Need to add a contact form? Say the word. Our AI assistant understands what you're going for and builds it beautifully—no dragging boxes around, no fighting with templates.

ADD A BLOG, PRODUCTS, AND MORE
Your site isn't just a pretty face. Create collections for blog posts, portfolio pieces, products, team members, testimonials—whatever your site needs. Add new items right from your phone, and they show up on your live site instantly. It's like having a CMS in your pocket (because, well, you do).ADD A BLOG, PRODUCTS, AND MORE


KNOW YOUR AUDIENCE
See how your site is performing with built-in analytics. Track page views, see where visitors come from, and read messages from people who reach out through your site. Everything you need to grow, right where you built it.

GO LIVE IN ONE TAP
When you're ready to share your creation with the world, just tap publish. Your site gets a clean, shareable URL instantly. No FTP clients, no hosting setup, no "what's a DNS record?" moments. Just tap and you're live.

BUILT FOR REAL PEOPLE
• No coding required – Seriously, not even a little bit
• AI that understands you – Describe changes in plain language
• Real-time preview – See updates as they happen
• Collections & content – Blog posts, products, galleries, and more
• Visitor messages – Hear directly from your audience
• Simple analytics – Know what's working
• Instant publishing – Live in seconds
• Dark mode – Because of course


WHO'S THIS FOR?
→ Freelancers who need a portfolio yesterday
→ Entrepreneurs launching a landing page for their idea
→ Small business owners who want an online presence without the hassle
→ Creators who'd rather create than code

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a vibe coding app for websites

quotes.text:
Hey everyone

I’ve been building an iOS app that lets you create and edit a full business website just by describing what you want. No agencies, no Webflow, no fiddling with layouts just vibe-code it straight from your phone.

You can ask it to build pages, tweak sections, add or remove content, and iterate on the site entirely from your pocket.

If your site includes a form, submissions land directly inside the app, and you also get basic analytics to see how your site is performing.

I built this mainly for founders and solo builders who want something fast and flexible without the usual setup pain.

Happy to answer questions or get feedback

Here is the app link : https://apps.apple.com/in/app/pocket-site/id6757796769
